Maar in Kinshasa had hij een andere tactiek, die de rope-a-dope zou worden genoemd. Ali de energieke ging in de touwen hangen, liet zijn tegenstander komen en putte hem uit door hem te omklemmen en over hem heen te hangen. Toen Foreman aan het einde van zijn krachten was, sloeg Ali toe: vijf stoten en een afmaker volstonden.

glosses: To clasp (someone or each other) in the arms with affection; to take in the arms; to hug.

examples.text: There was no faynting faith in that Dogge, which when his Master by a mischaunce in hunting stumbled and fell toppling downe a deepe dytche beyng vnable to recouer of himselfe, the Dogge signifying his masters mishappe, reskue came, and he was hayled up by a rope, whom the Dogge seeying almost drawne up to the edge of the dytche, cheerefully saluted, leaping and skipping vpon his master as though he would haue imbraced hym, beying glad of his presence, whose longer absence he was lothe to lacke.

glosses: To seize (something) eagerly or with alacrity; to accept or take up with cordiality; to welcome.

examples.text: I wholeheartedly embrace the new legislation.

I take it your owne buſineſſe cals on you, / And you embrace the occaſion to depart.

glosses: To submit to; to undergo.

examples.text: What I haue done my ſafety vrg'd me to: / And I embrace this fortune patiently, / Since not to be auoided it fals on me.

glosses: To encircle; to enclose, to encompass.

glosses: To enfold, to include (ideas, principles, etc.); to encompass.

examples.text: Natural philosophy embraces many sciences.

examples.text: He bears himſelfe more proudlier, / Euen to my perſon, then I thought he would / When firſt I did embrace him.

glosses: An enclosure partially or fully surrounding someone or something.

glosses: Full acceptance (of something).

examples.text: Chocolate seizes if a small amount of water (or watery liquid such as brandy) finds its way into the chocolate while it is melting. […] If chocolate seizes, it will look grainy and matte rather than glossy and smooth.
